text: Our parking facility, CityPark, offers secure covered and open-air parking spaces in the city center, with 24/7 CCTV surveillance and on-site security staff.
CityPark is located at 12 Market Street, downtown, two minutes' walk from the central train station and accessible from the main ring road.

No identity documents are required for a reservation. Customers only need to provide their name, surname, car registration number, and reservation period with the start and end date/time. Every reservation remains pending until it is confirmed by a parking administrator.
Reservations can be cancelled free of charge up to 2 hours before the reservation start time. Cancellations after that may incur a one-hour cancellation fee.
CityPark has four zones: A (standard), B (covered), C (long-term), and VIP (closest to the entrance, with valet option). Each zone has different hourly pricing.
Electric vehicle charging stations are available in Zone B. Disabled parking spaces are available in Zone A near the main entrance.
CityPark does not share customer personal data with third parties. Reservation details are only used for confirming and managing the parking reservation.
